title: Coherent contravariant exactness of native derived internal Hom
statement: Let C be a monoidal closed Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], with a braided, additive tensor and functorial flat resolutions. In its unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] use the native closed structure for the tensor induced by quasi-isomorphism localization. For every W the native internal-Hom functor [-,W]:D(C)^op → D(C) admits coherent commutation with all integral shifts and is triangulated for that structure. The source uses the opposite triangulated shift, which reverses the integer. No evaluation, biduality map or geometric object is part of this assertion.

proof.text: Choose a K-injective representative I and an isomorphism W ≅ Q I. Specialize lem-sf-bifunctor-homotopy-exact to the native internal-Hom bifunctor of C and I. Internal Hom is separately additive: the covariant functors are right adjoints of additive tensor functors, and precomposition is additive by pre_add_app. The result gives coherent integral shifts and triangulatedness of F=(bifunctorHomHomotopyFunctor internalHom I).leftOp on K(C)^op.

proof.text: The bifunctorHomObj specialization and native internalHomObj have definitionally identical objects and differentials. On each product projection, bifunctorHomMapLeft and internalHomPre both act by precomposition, so their maps agree. The native comparison qhInternalHomToIhom is invertible for K-injective I and natural for these maps. Choose complex representatives of objects of K(C), and lift a homotopy-category arrow to a chain map, to obtain a natural isomorphism F ≅ Qh.op ⋙ internalHom(-,Q I). Postcompose with the functorial isomorphism induced by Q I ≅ W.

proof.text: Use Functor.commShiftOfLocalization for Qh.op and the opposite quasi-isomorphism property to descend the coherent shifts of F to T=internalHom(-,W), using the natural isomorphism of step 2 as Localization.Lifting data. Its inverse automatically commutes with the descended shifts; taking its inverse gives shift compatibility of the original isomorphism. Transport triangulatedness of F across that isomorphism to Qh.op ⋙ T. The functor Qh.op is triangulated, and its functor on arrows is essentially surjective by the calculus of fractions for opposite homotopy quasi-isomorphisms. Functor.isTriangulated_of_precomp then proves T.IsTriangulated with exactly the descended CommShift structure.

lean.statement:
theorem nativeInternalHom_contravariant_exact
    (C : Type c) [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{v} C]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{v} C] [MonoidalCategory C] [MonoidalPreadditive C]
    [BraidedCategory C] [MonoidalClosed C] [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution C]
    (W : DerivedCategory C) :
    ∃ s : (MonoidalClosed.internalHom.flip.obj W).CommShift ℤ,
      letI := s
      (MonoidalClosed.internalHom.flip.obj W).IsTriangulated
